text: Design studies is an interdisciplinary subject that integrates artistic creativity, technical logic and humanistic care. It focuses on solving the relationship problems between "people and objects, people and the environment, people and systems", and achieves the unity of function, aesthetics and social value through creative thinking and practice. Its research scope covers fields such as visual communication, product design, environmental design, interaction design, and service design, involving the entire process from concept conception to implementation. It features artistic, engineering, and commercial characteristics.
